change_summary: Restore GitHub Releases as a receipt-verified immutable mirror of the canonical website Agent Skills packages without restoring a broad cross-repository publisher token.

canonical_skill.note: The package release marker advances with the public distribution contract; the Skill behavior and compatibility floor remain unchanged.

server_contract.note: Machine-readable contracts expose exact versioned GitHub Release archives and checksums alongside the canonical Corvio URLs.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together because exported source and immutable release assets change as one package family.

workspace_cli.note: CLI commands and npm package versions are unchanged.

help_center.note: Claude setup guidance identifies the GitHub Release as a byte-identical immutable fallback while retaining Corvio as canonical origin.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the synchronized Skill release and collaboration revision.

harness_and_mainline.note: The release mainline records one canonical artifact identity with website origin and GitHub Release projection, plus receipt-backed completion.

external_marketplaces.note: External marketplace review remains account-owned and is not implied by first-party publication.

public_release_assets.note: The public repository uses its scoped GITHUB_TOKEN to publish exact website bytes, while the private release owner waits for workflow and asset parity readback.

release_evidence.note: Trigger, transfer, countercase, idempotency and contract tests cover missing or divergent immutable assets and the user-visible fallback.
